clauses.scope_note: Applies to Customer’s access to and use of the Cohere API SaaS Services upon expiration or earlier termination. Cohere will, at Customer’s request, delete or render inaccessible remaining Customer Data, including Custom Models, within 30 days; that deletion provision excludes API Data and Finetuning Data submitted under Section 3(a)(iii). The data deletion terms are not represented as artifact-use permissions.
clauses.condition_explanation: The obligation to cease access and use is triggered by expiration or earlier termination of the Agreement.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to Customer’s access to or use of the Cohere API SaaS Services; it does not state a general restriction on other Cohere Products.
clauses.condition_explanation: While accessing or using the Cohere API SaaS Services, Customer must comply with export laws and regulations that apply to that access or use.

coverage_notes: This chunk contains terms scoped to the Cohere API SaaS Services; they should not be treated as terms for every Cohere Product or a repository software license.

Section 341 addresses deletion and retention of Customer Data, Custom Models, API Data, and Finetuning Data, but those data are not among the allowed object kinds, so no separate data-object clause is encoded.
The chunk references Section 3(a)(iii) for the exception to deletion; that provision is outside this chunk.
